title: koeleria spicata subsp. alaskana
intro: Koeleria spicata subsp. alaskana, commonly known as Alaskan June Grass, is a perennial grass species native to Alaska. It has been used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. Alaskan June Grass is said to have therapeutic actions such as soothing digestive issues and relieving respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, although further research is needed to confirm its exact bioactive properties.
